intro: This Auraline almirah is a fusion of elegance and function. With mirrored shutters, thoughtfully designed compartments and a numeric drawer, it empowers you to live clutter-free and refined.

features.title: Keep valuables safe and sound
features.text: Equipped with a high-security numeric lock, this almirah protects your most important belongings so you can rest easy.

features.title: Smart storage for daily essentials
features.text: The drawers, including a spacious bottom drawer, are perfect for organising shoes, accessories, and other items you use every day.

features.title: Clothing made accessible
features.text: The lowered hanging rod is designed for comfortable and effortless access to your wardrobe, saving you time and effort.

features.title: Dedicated shoe storage
features.text: A dedicated drawer keeps your footwear neat and easy to find, giving your bedroom a clean and clutter-free look.

features.title: Handy wired basket for quick access
features.text: The wired basket is great for frequently used items, making them easy to grab whenever you need them.

name: Auraline Women Premium 2-Door Steel Almirah With Mirror Rocky Grey
